fields.name: Emma
fields.comment: Tastes exactly like a strawberry milkshake but in a can. My new favourite.

fields.name: Liam
fields.comment: Really creamy and not too sweet. Would love a bigger can option.

fields.name: Sophie
fields.comment: So refreshing! The chocolate chips give it a nice bit of texture.

fields.name: Noah
fields.comment: Great mint flavour, cools you right down. Perfect after the gym.

fields.name: Harper
fields.comment: Best mint choc chip drink I've had, tastes like a proper milkshake.

fields.name: Leo
fields.comment: Nice but the mint is a bit strong for me personally.

fields.name: Amelia
fields.comment: So cooling and refreshing, perfect summer drink.

fields.name: Aisha
fields.comment: Such a treat, the strawberry flavour is so natural tasting.

fields.name: Tom
fields.comment: Great texture, will definitely buy again.

fields.name: Isabelle
fields.comment: The salty pretzel crunch you get from the aftertaste is unreal. Addictive.

fields.name: James
fields.comment: Good but a little too sweet for my taste. Still finished the can though.

fields.name: Priya
fields.comment: The sweet and salty combo is spot on, my favourite of the range.

fields.name: Marcus
fields.comment: Really moreish, the pretzel bits give it a nice crunch note.

fields.name: Chloe
fields.comment: Banana and peanut butter together is genius. Tastes like dessert in a can.

fields.name: Ethan
fields.comment: Thick and filling, great as a snack replacement. Shake it well first!

fields.name: Sofia
fields.comment: Tastes like a peanut butter banana smoothie, so good.

fields.name: Jack
fields.comment: Tasty but very rich, one can is definitely enough.

fields.name: Nadia
fields.comment: My go-to post-workout treat now, love the flavour balance.

fields.name: Mia
fields.comment: Vanilla and marshmallow is so cosy, tastes like a cup of hot cocoa.

fields.name: Benjamin
fields.comment: Sweet without being sickly. Great one to keep in the fridge for guests.

fields.name: Freya
fields.comment: Tastes like a toasted marshmallow campfire treat. Lovely and sweet.

fields.name: Owen
fields.comment: Comforting flavour, great with a splash of coffee too.

fields.name: Zoe
fields.comment: Rich chocolate with a caramel finish, honestly better than a milkshake.

fields.name: Daniel
fields.comment: My favourite of the whole range. Dangerously easy to finish in one sitting.

fields.name: Ruby
fields.comment: Chocolate and caramel is a classic combo and this nails it perfectly.

fields.name: Felix
fields.comment: Rich and indulgent, great as an evening treat.
